results.primary_cause: Evidence indicates stronger Capesize freight conditions and higher apparent 2026 dry-bulk rates, but the evidence also attributes some strength to rerouting and warns of a prospective supply glut; the underlying commodity-volume cycle is therefore unresolved.

supporting_evidence.claim: A key measure of bulk-shipping rates reached its highest level since December 2023, driven by rising Capesize demand and tightening vessel supply.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

supporting_evidence.claim: BIMCO-linked reporting described apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength and a potential reversal of the rerouting-related boost.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse

counter_evidence.claim: The reported 2026 market strength was characterized as substantially artificial and driven by forced rerouting, with a 2027 supply glut risk that could reverse the boost.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse

counter_evidence.claim: Dry-bulk earnings are highly sensitive to freight rates, but the available report focuses on market valuation and does not establish durable commodity-volume demand.
counter_evidence.source_title: Euroseas Ltd Stock (MHY235261073): valuation in focus after strong bulk shipping cycle

results.primary_cause: Available evidence points to continued storage growth and evolving NAND/controller demand, but it does not establish a sufficiently current, unambiguous NAND pricing, inventory or module-cycle change; the evidence is also indirect and mixed.

supporting_evidence.claim: The source discusses potential AI-storage and NAND-controller demand, but the available prefetched material does not provide a verified current cycle metric.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Silicon Motion Award Spotlights AI Storage And NAND Controller Potential

supporting_evidence.claim: The 2026 Future of Memory and Storage Conference was described as showing continued storage and memory market growth.
supporting_evidence.source_title: 2026 FMS Shows Storage And Memory Market Continued Growth

counter_evidence.claim: The available source discusses NAND supply-demand dynamics but does not provide a time-consistent current pricing, inventory or module-transmission measure sufficient to confirm the nominated cycle.
counter_evidence.source_title: The Next NAND Decade: Why Supply Can’t Catch Demand The Way It Used To

counter_evidence.claim: A report on Phison describes evolving storage demand and SSD adoption, but this is company- and theme-level evidence rather than proof of an industry-wide NAND cycle.
counter_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving
